payload.name: Magic Wheelchair
payload.description: Magic Wheelchair is a nonprofit organization that builds epic wheelchair costumes — at no cost to families.

paragraph: Magic Wheelchair is a nonprofit organization based in Oregon that transforms wheelchairs into amazing costumes—think superhero suits, favorite characters, or anything else a child dreams up—completely free for families. If your child uses a wheelchair and loves Halloween, themed events, or just wants to feel extra special during everyday adventures, this is a wonderful resource to know about. It's a simple but powerful way to celebrate your child's personality and interests while making their mobility device part of the fun.
